rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose everyday verb for attaching, tying, or fastening one thing to another.

example.english: I used a rope to hitch the two boards together.
example.traditional: 我用條繩將兩塊木板綁埋一齊。
example.jyutping: ngo5 jung6 tiu4 sing4 zoeng1 loeng5 faai3 muk6 baan2 bong2 maai4 jat1 cai4

rows.note: Use this for the informal English sense of getting hitched; Cantonese does not need a special informal verb here.

example.english: They dated for years and finally decided to hitch up.
example.traditional: 佢哋拍拖多年，終於決定結婚喇。
example.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 paak3 to1 do1 nin4 zung1 jyu1 kyut3 ding6 git3 fan1 laa3

rows.note: Use this specifically when pulling clothing or another object upward with a sharp tug.

example.english: Your trousers are slipping, so hitch them up quickly.
example.traditional: 你條褲跌緊，快啲扯高返佢啦。
example.jyutping: nei5 tiu4 fu3 dit3 gan2 faai3 di1 ce2 gou1 faan2 keoi5 laa1
